assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and persistent dizziness, raising concern for an underlying arrhythmic etiology.
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9).
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to evaluate for intermittent conduction abnormalities or atrial fibrillation.
CPT code 93247 represents a long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study.
The claim for CPT code 93247 has been denied.
The denial is based on Reason Code PR-204.
The specific service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan.
